title: A verify skill per repo that drives the real thing, claude-settings hooks first
why: Owner, 19:45 CST Nov 17 (relayed by the consultant): review the Claude Code team blogs https://claude.dev/blog/how-the-claude-code-team-thinks-about-verification/ and https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic/ and land their findings. Triage read both through a page summary, not word for word. Finding: Verification blog: run the change end to end, codified in a `verify` skill under .claude/skills/ that Claude runs before committing; running the app matters more than tests.
source: owner words 19:45 CST Nov 17 via the consultant; blogs read through a page summary
note: Harm if missing: our rule says a green check proves only its fixtures, yet most lanes (the standing-merge-role hook lane included) are proven by fixture tests alone. Brief: test-author first writes a case that starts a fresh cloud container's hook and reads the recorded role (red on a build without the hook); builder writes the skill for claude-settings hooks only; other repos follow as their own steps. Proof command: the skill's own run through `verdict` in a fresh clone. Not built.
